name: treemap/nightly-check/12-should-apply-classdef-fill-color-to-leaf-nodes.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Root" with three flat leaves; two of the three (Item A,
  Item C) are tagged with distinct classDefs (redClass, blueClass) that set
  only a fill color, verifying classDef fill-color styling applies
  correctly to individual leaf nodes.
---
treemap-beta
  "Root"
    "Item A": 30:::redClass
    "Item B": 20
    "Item C": 25:::blueClass

  classDef redClass fill:#ff0000;
  classDef blueClass fill:#0000ff;

name: treemap/nightly-check/14-should-apply-classdef-color-to-text-labels.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Products" with two sections (Electronics, Furniture), each
  styled with a classDef that sets a background fill plus a text color
  (white text on a dark fill vs black text on a light fill), verifying
  classDef color styling applies to node text labels.
---
treemap-beta
  "Products"
    "Electronics":::whiteText
      "Phones": 40
      "Laptops": 30
    "Furniture":::darkText
      "Chairs": 25
      "Tables": 20

  classDef whiteText fill:#2c3e50,color:#ffffff;
  classDef darkText fill:#ecf0f1,color:#000000;

name: treemap/nightly-check/15-should-apply-multiple-classdef-properties-simultaneously.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Budget" with two sections (Critical, Normal), each styled
  via a classDef that combines fill, text color, stroke color, and
  stroke-width simultaneously, verifying multiple classDef properties can
  be applied together to a single node.
---
treemap-beta
  "Budget"
    "Critical":::critical
      "Server Costs": 50000
      "Salaries": 80000
    "Normal":::normal
      "Office Supplies": 5000
      "Marketing": 15000

  classDef critical fill:#e74c3c,color:#fff,stroke:#c0392b,stroke-width:3px;
  classDef normal fill:#3498db,color:#fff,stroke:#2980b9,stroke-width:1px;

name: treemap/nightly-check/16-should-handle-classdef-on-nested-sections-and-leaves.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Company" with a nested Engineering section (styled via its
  own classDef) whose leaves are further tagged individually with a second
  "highlight" classDef, plus a sibling Sales section with one highlighted
  leaf. Verifies classDef styling can be layered at both the nested-section
  level and the individual-leaf level within the same diagram.
---
treemap-beta
  "Company"
    "Engineering":::engSection
      "Frontend": 30:::highlight
      "Backend": 40
      "DevOps": 20:::highlight
    "Sales"
      "Direct": 35
      "Channel": 25:::highlight

  classDef engSection fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#8e44ad,stroke-width:2px;
  classDef highlight fill:#f39c12,color:#000,stroke:#e67e22,stroke-width:2px;

text:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta mirroring the example used in the treemap documentation: two
  sections where Section 1 nests a sub-section (Section 1.2) with its own
  leaf, while Section 2 is flat with three leaves; a classDef (class1) is
  applied to both a nested section and a leaf to show styling can target
  either level.

name: treemap/pr-check/13-should-apply-classdef-stroke-styles-to-sections.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta with two sections, each tagged with a distinct classDef:
  Category A gets a thick solid red border (stroke-width 8px), Category B
  gets a dashed black border (stroke-dasharray) of the same width, verifying
  classDef stroke styling (solid vs dashed, color) applies to section
  containers.
---
treemap-beta
  %% This is a comment
  "Category A":::thickBorder
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  %% Another comment
  "Category B":::dashedBorder
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

  classDef thickBorder stroke:red,stroke-width:8px;
  classDef dashedBorder stroke:black,stroke-dasharray:5,stroke-width:8px;
